summary: Second pass at commit 0053305: both fix_tasks resolved. Migration 0004, the integrity gate, both views and reservar_presupuesto_de_ingesta remain correct.
notes: SECOND PASS (2026-08-28, commit 0053305): approve. Both fix_tasks from the first pass are resolved.
The four English 'test_' prefixes are gone (grep finds zero matches in either test file) and the renames are pure, with no assertion changed.

The gate test is now tied to the STRICT abort: it orphans a real movimientos row by excluding reservas id=1 from the copy, then asserts the error text contains the 'cannot store TEXT value in INTEGER column' fragment AND 'saldo.disponible', plus post-rollback survival of reservas id=1 and of the consumo_por_conversacion view, plus user_version == 3. It cannot pass on an unrelated failure.
No pre-existing test was deleted or weakened: the only two deletion lines across both test files are the renamed fn signature and OBJETOS_ESPERADOS going 14 to 15.
The six acceptance-coverage gaps are a blueprint annotation artifact (test_scenarios lack covers: AC-n), not missing tests.
Verdict persisted by the orchestrator because the reviewer role is read-only by construction and cannot write this artifact.

OBSERVATION worth carrying forward: the contract's banned-English-word guard forced the test to split a string literal (concat! of two halves) in order to assert SQLite's own English error message. The guard is making correct code contort; a future guard of this family should exempt string literals that assert an external system's message.
